summary: security checked in 2 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance, dependency controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not proof of compromise. Exact decision: maintain private launch gates; continue only existing bounded read-only security evidence work; permit ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not deploy, requeue failed work, change configuration, access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, or conduct external outreach. No clean bill of health or certification is supported.

Continue existing bounded read-only evidence capture for authentication and access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, build and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. Record timestamps, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications. Do not create duplicate telemetry requests or new production work.
